name: Article 6, after § 1 – 71
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council on the Public interface connected to the Internal Market Information System for the declaration of posting of workers and amending Regulation (EU) No 1024/2012
part_text: The European Labour Authority may receive only aggregated and anonymised statistical data derived from posting declarations submitted through the public interface, which shall not allow the identification of any natural person or individual undertaking. The European Labour Authority shall not have access to individual posting declarations or to documents submitted through the public interface and shall use those statistical data exclusively for the analyses referred to in Article 10 of Regulation (EU) 2019/1149.
